padding_boundary.note: Presented as saving a whole extra padding block for 56-byte tails (<= instead of <); with 56 bytes buffered the 0x80 marker and the bit length overlap, so every message whose length is 56 mod 64 hashes wrongly.

ref_prefix_compare.note: Presented as letting verify_with_ref compare against a caller's larger buffer without a length branch; any reference that starts with the digest and has trailing bytes now verifies as true. Upstream and property tests only pass 32-byte and shorter references.

store_to_be_bytes.note: Presented as a faster digest serialization (u32::to_be_bytes instead of four shifted byte stores); it runs once per digest, so the instruction count does not move by the required 1%.
